title: Provider consent Brand scope inside personal Root Workspaces

phases.objective: Allow an exact Brand provider-connection scope inside a canonical personal Root Workspace without weakening personal ownership or Brand authority checks.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user operating inside their personal Root Workspace with an exact Brand scope
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The personal Root owner may list or authorize Brand-scoped provider connections only after exact Brand authority is verified, while a non-owner is denied before Brand or connection lookup.
steps: Resolve authenticated tenant membership and exact personal Root Workspace ownership.
Verify the authenticated user owns the personal Root Workspace before any Brand authority lookup.
Resolve exact Brand authority and project Brand-owned provider connections without credential payloads.
Issue an authorize consent state for the exact Brand scope when provider_connection.manage is granted.
Repeat with a different personal Root owner and verify failure occurs before Brand authority, connection lookup, or consent issuance.
assertions: Root Workspace ownership remains personal; Brand is an owner scope inside that Root Workspace rather than a third Root ownership mode.
Personal Root owner mismatch returns provider_consent_personal_owner_mismatch before Brand authority lookup.
Brand list resolution requires exact tenant/workspace/Brand/principal authority and returns ownerScopeType=brand.
Brand authorize resolution requires provider_connection.manage and passes exact Root Workspace plus Brand owner scope into consent issuance.
Projected connection results do not expose credential payloads or secrets.
No live provider call, credential read, database migration, Production mutation, or external effect is executed by the regression.
